subject: June metering: allocation decisions and payment cutoff
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@marketplace-finance.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace-notify@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: June marketplace invoice — allocation question & cutoff window

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

We're reconciling the June AWS Marketplace invoice for GreenGrid (account GG-889) and a couple of items came up we need your guidance on before payments are issued: 

1) Regional allocation: a subset of the usage (line items 7-9 in the attached CSV) were billed under the EU reseller footprint but should be allocated to the UK direct entity. Can Redwood confirm whether you want us to reclassify those lines on the invoice or issue a separate credit note?

2) VAT handling: the invoice shows VAT applied at 20% for the EU lines. GreenGrid indicated they submitted a UK VAT registration after consumption started — we have their partial certificate attached but need confirmation from Redwood tax whether we should apply a VAT credit or wait for a full certificate to avoid re-openings.

3) Payment cutoff: our disbursement window closes on 2026-07-10. If we do reclassifications that affect net payable >€10k, we can either push GreenGrid to July 17 payout or issue an interim settlement and apply an offset on next month. Which do you prefer?

I've attached the usage report and the draft invoice.

[Attachment: usage_report_CUST-889.csv (CSV, 43KB)]
[Attachment: invoice_JUN2026_GG-889.pdf (PDF, 112KB)]

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

— Elena
Elena Rossi
Marketplace Billing Ops
Marketplace Finance Partners
elena@marketplace-finance.com
+44 20 7946 0123
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@marketplace-finance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: June marketplace invoice — allocation question & cutoff window

Elena — thanks for the notes and attachments. Quick replies below; we'll follow up with formal confirmation by end of day tomorrow.

- Allocation: prefer a reclassification on this invoice (single document) rather than a separate credit if it's possible on your side — reduces reconciliation work for GreenGrid. If that would delay the payout past your 7/10 cutoff by more than 72h, tell us and we'll accept an interim offset on July.

- VAT: looping Vanessa (Tax) to confirm whether a provisional credit is acceptable with the partial certificate. Vanessa — can you confirm if we can apply a provisional VAT zero-rate pending final UK VAT registration? If not, we'll request GreenGrid to provide the full certificate before settlement.

- Collections: Marcus, pls flag whether the finance team can tolerate a July 17 disbursement for this account if the marketplace needs the extra week. If not, we'll request the interim settlement workflow.

Attached for internal reference: Redwood VAT cert (copied).

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena@marketplace-finance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: June marketplace invoice — allocation question & cutoff window

On Wed, 1 Jul 2026 at 18:12, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the notes and attachments. Quick replies below; we'll follow up with formal confirmation by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks for looping me in. Short answer: we can accept a provisional VAT correction for UK-domiciled consumption provided that GreenGrid supplies a formal VAT registration number and signed declaration within 30 days. The steps we'd need the marketplace to take:

- Reclassify the lines to the UK entity and aggregate VAT at the UK rate (if applicable).
- Issue a provisional credit for EU VAT and indicate on the invoice that final VAT will be confirmed upon receipt of registration docs.
- Provide an auditable trail PDF (invoice + reclassification note) and route that to our tax mailbox (tax@redwood.ai).

If GreenGrid cannot provide the registration promptly, we should not issue final credits; an interim offset on the July disbursement is safer.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Tax Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vat_certificate_redwood.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]
From: Elena Rossi <elena@marketplace-finance.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 12:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: June marketplace invoice — allocation question & cutoff window

Thanks Vanessa — that's helpful. GreenGrid confirmed they'll push the full UK VAT registration and signed declaration by Friday 2026-07-04.

Given that timeline, we can proceed as follows:

- We'll reclassify the three lines to the UK entity and apply a provisional credit for EU VAT on the June invoice.
- We'll hold final settlement docs pending GreenGrid's registration but can do an interim settlement for the non-VAT net amount on 2026-07-10 so funds aren't delayed. The VAT component will be reconciled once registration is received.

Please confirm you want the interim settlement (net amount) on 7/10 and final VAT reconciliation in July 30 run.

— Elena
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@marketplace-finance.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: June marketplace invoice — allocation question & cutoff window

Elena / team — confirmed. Action summary:

1) Elena/Marketplace: reclassify lines 7-9 to the UK entity and apply provisional VAT credit for those lines. Issue interim settlement for the net payable (excluding provisional VAT) on 2026-07-10.

2) GreenGrid: provide full UK VAT registration + signed declaration by 2026-07-04 (Elena has confirmation it will arrive).

3) Redwood Tax (Vanessa): once docs arrive, Redwood tax will review and sign off. If everything is in order, marketplace may issue a VAT correction and include it in the July 30 settlement run. If not, we'll take the standard dispute route.

4) Finance (Marcus): allow the interim payout on 7/10 for the net amount; expect a follow-up credit / payout adjustment in the July 30 run. Marcus — please reply if this is rejected by Collections.

Thanks everyone — please keep this thread for audit trail. I'll update the HubSpot record once final documents are received.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
